main.description: Lists a community's threads, most recently active first. Threads the requesting user may not read are absent rather than refused.

community.description: The community to list threads in.

channel.description: Restrict the list to threads in one channel. Absent lists every channel's threads, which is what the community sidebar needs.

limit.description: Maximum number of threads to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous call.
Pagination cursor for the next page.

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: The request has no valid service auth.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The requesting user is not a member of this community.

errors.name: CommunityNotFound
errors.description: No community matches the given DID.

errors.name: ChannelNotFound
errors.description: No channel matches the given space reference.
